test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Judicious
solution: The correct answer is: **Sensible**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Judicious **means having or showing good judgment or sense. (अच्छा निर्णय या समझ रखना) • **Example**: *The judge made a judicious decision by carefully considering all the evidence presented in the trial before reaching a verdict.* • Marked option **Sensible **means having or showing good sense or practical judgment. (अच्छी समझ या व्यावहारिक निर्णय दिखाना) • **Example**: *The CEO made a sensible decision to invest in new technology to improve efficiency.* • So, Sensible is a synonym for judicious. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Imprudent **means lacking good judgment or wisdom. (अच्छे निर्णय या बुद्धि का अभाव) • **Careless **means not taking enough care or attention. (पर्याप्त देखभाल या ध्यान न देना) • **Short-sighted** means lacking foresight or understanding of consequences. (परिणामों की दूरदर्शिता या समझ का अभाव) 158:T884, The correct answer is: **Route**
